question: 活动日当天转化率比前 7 天每日转化率的均值高多少（相对提升幅度）
gold_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT max_dt AS promo_dt FROM meta_dataset_range WHERE id = 1), promo AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN user_id END) AS buy_users, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS uv FROM dwd_behavior_fact WHERE dt = (SELECT promo_dt FROM p)), base AS (SELECT AVG(bu / NULLIF(u, 0)) AS rate FROM (SELECT dt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN user_id END) AS bu, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS u FROM dwd_behavior_fact WHERE dt BETWEEN (SELECT DATE_SUB(promo_dt, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM p) AND (SELECT DATE_SUB(promo_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM p) GROUP BY dt) t) SELECT ROUND((promo.buy_users / NULLIF(promo.uv, 0) - base.rate) / NULLIF(base.rate, 0), 4) AS lift FROM promo, base
note: 转化率=成交人数/访问人数(uv)，分母不是 pv_users；基线=前 7 天每日转化率的均值，不是 7 天合并后算一个率

question: 活动日成交人数比前 7 天每日成交人数的均值高多少（相对提升幅度）
gold_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT max_dt AS promo_dt FROM meta_dataset_range WHERE id = 1), promo AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS v FROM dwd_behavior_fact   WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' AND dt = (SELECT promo_dt FROM p)), daily AS (SELECT dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS v FROM dwd_behavior_fact   WHERE behavior_type = 'buy'     AND dt BETWEEN (SELECT DATE_SUB(promo_dt, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM p)                AND (SELECT DATE_SUB(promo_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM p)   GROUP BY dt), base AS (SELECT AVG(v) AS v FROM daily) SELECT ROUND((promo.v - base.v) / NULLIF(base.v, 0), 4) AS lift FROM promo, base
